# ADR Kit

> ADR Kit is a command-line tool for Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
> Plain Markdown records follow four lifecycle folders: proposed, implemented,
> rejected, archived. Built for humans and AI coding assistants.

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/luochang212/adr-kit
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/adr-kit
- CLI reference: https://github.com/luochang212/adr-kit/blob/main/docs/cli.md
- Record format: https://github.com/luochang212/adr-kit/blob/main/docs/record-format.md
- Workflow guide: https://github.com/luochang212/adr-kit/blob/main/docs/workflow.md

## Quick start

```bash
npm install -g adr-kit
cd your-project
adrkit init
adrkit propose "Use SQLite for session storage"
# Once shipped:
adrkit implement "Use SQLite for session storage" --raised-by human --decided-by human
adrkit validate
```

Use `adrkit record "<title>" --raised-by human --decided-by human` for an
already-shipped choice. Use `adrkit reject <name> --reason "<the tempting
mistake this blocks>"` for a formally declined proposal; keep a rejection only
while it still teaches. Full supersession archives the old implemented record;
`adrkit archive <N> --reason "<current authority>"` retires other implemented
records that no longer guide work.

## Key facts

- The four folders are a context budget: read `implemented/` in full, check
  `proposed/` for intent and `rejected/` for anti-patterns, and leave `archived/`
  alone unless a task cites history.
- `proposed/` and `rejected/` hold dated, unnumbered files; `implemented/`
  and `archived/` hold stable numbered files.
- A settled but unshipped direction remains proposed. There is no separate
  local draft folder; Git distinguishes uncommitted work from shared proposals.
- `adrkit validate` checks all four folders and the `adr/archived/MANIFEST.json`
  content seal; `adrkit validate --base <git-ref>` proves the archive only grew.
  Fresh templates intentionally fail until required sections contain real
  content.
- `raised-by` and `decided-by` are required on numbered decisions; each is
  declared as `human` or `agent`. The CLI cannot infer provenance or verify
  delivery.
- `adrkit tree <name>` renders an optional `## Deliberation` design tree;
  `adrkit graph --html` renders the numbered decision history.
- At task start, list the inventory, read relevant implemented records in full,
  check relevant proposals and rejections, and consult archives for history.
- The `adrkit-review` skill keeps changed records aligned with changed code and
  tests; it is scoped to decision-record coherence, not general code review.
- Integrations install in `.agents/` by default; `--tools claude` adds
  `.claude/`, and `--tools none` installs nothing.
- License: MIT. Single runtime dependency: yaml.
